title: Apartamento T5 Duplex com Lugares de Garagem em Aveiro
description:
Sublime e elegante apartamento de tipologia T5 Duplex situado ao nível do 3º andar, inserido num empreendimento de luxo, no Centro da maravilhosa Cidade de Aveiro. 

Este apartamento, caracterizado por excelentes áreas, é distribuído, no seu piso inferior, por um amoroso hall de entrada, uma ampla e espaçosa sala e cozinha em open space, totalmente equipada com frigorífico, forno, microondas, máquina de lavar louça e placa de indução, dispondo de acesso à lavandaria, para tratamento de roupa, equipada com máquina de lavar e secar roupa, e a uma aprazível varanda, ideal para momentos de lazer.

Ainda neste piso, encontramos um hall de quartos, uma casa de banho completa, 1 suite com casa de banho privativa e roupeiros embutidos e um outro quarto com roupeiros embutidos, sendo que ambos dispõem de acesso à varanda.

Subindo ao piso superior deste magnífico apartamento, encontramos uma casa de banho completa, 1 suite com casa de banho privativa e roupeiros embutidos e mais 2 quartos com roupeiros embutidos, sendo que todos dispõem de acesso a um maravilhoso terraço.

Ao apartamento pertencem ainda 2 lugares de garagem.

Sublime and elegant 5 bedroom duplex apartment, located on the 3rd floor of a luxury development in the centre of the beautiful city of Aveiro.

The apartment, which is characterised by its excellent proportions, is divided on the ground floor into a lovely entrance hall, a large and spacious living room and an open-plan kitchen, fully equipped with fridge, oven, microwave, dishwasher and induction hob, with access to the laundry room, equipped with washing machine and tumble dryer, and to a pleasant balcony, ideal for moments of leisure.

Also on this floor we find a hallway with bedrooms, a full bathroom, 1 en-suite bedroom with fitted wardrobes and another bedroom with fitted wardrobes, both with access to the balcony.

Going up to the top floor of this magnificent apartment, we find a full bathroom, 1 en-suite bedroom with fitted wardrobes and 2 further bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, all with access to a lovely terrace.

The apartment also has 2 parking spaces.

A Casa Da Joana é uma empresa ligada ao ramo imobiliário que nasceu na cidade de Aveiro. Distingue-se pela seleção rigorosa e criteriosa dos imóveis que promove e que apresenta aos seus clientes. Assume-se como um conceito descontraído, onde encontrar a casa ideal, e o mais apaixonante possível, são as palavras de ordem.

A proximidade e a empatia que firma com os clientes cria laços e estabelece uma relação de confiança e credibilidade igualáveis.

Estamos no mercado para dar cor e paixão ao mercado imobiliário e combater um pouco o modelo tradicional de compra e venda de imóveis.

A nossa casa é o local mais especial da nossa vida e, por isso, escolhê-la é um processo que deverá ser assessorado com toda a importância e cuidado que ele merece.

A Casa Da Joana is a real estate company that was born in the city of Aveiro. It stands out for its rigorous and careful selection of the properties it promotes and presents to its clients. It sees itself as a relaxed concept, where finding the ideal home, and the most exciting one possible, are the watchwords.

The closeness and empathy it builds with its clients creates bonds and establishes a relationship of trust and credibility that can't be matched.

We are on the market to bring color and passion to the real estate market and to combat the traditional model of buying and selling property.

Our home is the most special place in our lives and, for this reason, choosing it is a process that should be advised with all the importance and care it deserves.

Joana Portela Lda. | AMI: 13535. 

Categoria Energética: A

Sublime and elegant flat, typology T5 Duplex, located on the 3rd floor, inserted in a luxury development, in the centre of the wonderful city of Aveiro.

This flat, characterised by excellent areas, is distributed, on its lower floor, by a lovely entrance hall, a large and spacious living room and kitchen in open space, fully equipped with fridge, oven, microwave, dishwasher and induction hob, with access to the laundry room, for laundry treatment, equipped with washing machine and dryer, and a pleasant balcony, ideal for leisure time.

Also on this floor, we find a hall of bedrooms, a full bathroom, 1 suite with a private bathroom and built-in wardrobes and another bedroom with built-in wardrobes, both of which have access to the balcony.

Going up to the top floor of this magnificent flat, we find a full bathroom, 1 suite with private bathroom and built-in wardrobes and 2 more bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, all of which have access to a wonderful terrace.

The flat also has 2 parking spaces.
